data.body: Follow-up Gerrit 3327 (merged 81f77e00568, deployed and healthy 16:35 PST): the lock keeps its original name recent-creates.lock in the tracker git dir; the mechanism-ok marker is removed and the baseline entry restored, so the mechanism ratchet exits 0 with no marker for it. A new test holds the journal lock in one process and checks that a process with a different .rebar finds the same lock file taken (and can take it after release); it fails when the journal is keyed on the per-process .rebar. make verify on the final tree: 20814 passed plus 202 integration, exit 0.
